legalNotice.title: Legal notice
legalNotice.intro: Verified legal and contact information for the current Todijo project and service.

sections.title: Current status
sections.body: Todijo is currently a pre-incorporation marketplace project and service. It is not yet an incorporated company and must not be understood as an existing ‘Todijo SAS’. The intended future legal form is a French SAS.

sections.title: Information pending incorporation
sections.body: A SIREN/SIRET or RCS registration, VAT number, registered office, company capital, legal representative and publication director are not currently available. Verified details that become applicable will be added after incorporation. No data protection officer has been appointed.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For support, legal or privacy questions concerning the current service, contact support@todijo.com. Todijo does not publish unverified hosting or company identity details.

rules.title: Marketplace rules
rules.intro: Practical rules for buying, selling and communicating safely on Todijo.

sections.title: Seller status and accurate listings
sections.body: Sellers must truthfully declare whether they act as a professional/trader or a private/non-professional seller. The status is seller-declared unless Todijo expressly confirms a real verification. Listings must accurately state the title, description, images, price, condition, stock, variants and relevant product or safety information.

sections.title: Legal products and product safety
sections.body: Illegal, unsafe, counterfeit, rights-infringing or otherwise prohibited products and listings are not allowed. This rule is not an exhaustive catalogue of every restricted product. Sellers remain responsible for lawful products and for providing manufacturer, responsible-person, warning, instruction or other compliance information where applicable.

sections.title: Communication, orders and reviews
sections.body: Use Todijo messaging honestly and respectfully. Fraud, harassment, spam and platform misuse are forbidden. Sellers must process orders honestly and keep stock and fulfilment information accurate. Reviews must concern genuine marketplace experiences and must not be fabricated, purchased or manipulated.

sections.title: Reporting and enforcement
sections.body: Users can report products or listings as illegal, unsafe, misleading, prohibited or for another supported reason. Todijo may review available information and, where justified under these rules or the Terms, restrict or remove content or seller access. A platform review is not an automated legal determination.

sections.title: Buyer rights and related policies
sections.body: These practical rules do not replace statutory consumer rights, the Marketplace Terms, Seller Terms or Refund/Return Policy. Rights may differ depending on whether the seller is legally a trader or a private person.
